Render

Imagem final: matéria, ambiente e pós-produção.

PROMPT

BUILDING Programe, volume, fixed elements and viewpoint

This is a culltural center with a library

CONTEXT

This is in South Korea. Keep the trees in the surroundings. Delete all the cars and add more people strolling (families with kids playing on the grass). Delete the wet look on the ground. Zoom the image a little bit out so we can see more of the building. to that, keep the curved movement of the roof, but make the curves become progressively smaller and go a bit down as they reach the margins of the photo.

MATERIALS

Keep the materials as they are

LIGHT Time, orientation, atmosphere, intensity and contrast

this image shows a late afternoon scene and the sky shows sunset colors

PRESERVE What must be preserved and unchanged

let's preserve the overall dimensions, proportions and fidelity of the elements.
